statement: Industry estimates cited in the report project NAND demand for Nvidia Rubin CMX context-memory servers rising from 35 million TB this year to more than 100 million TB next year, described as adding an Apple-sized source of demand.
why: A new AI-server memory tier that consumes NAND at this scale would absorb a large share of industry bit output and tighten allocation for everyone else.

impact.mechanism: A step change in AI-server NAND consumption tightens memory and storage supply available to other buyers even as it lifts revenue for memory makers.

evidence.excerpt: Industry estimates suggest that NAND demand for CMX will surge from 35 million TB this year to more than 100 million TB next year.

confidence.basis: Secondary enthusiast outlet syndicating an analyst comment and Korean press report; figures are forward projections, not measured shipments, so no value is recorded.
